description: This file contains utility functions for security-related operations, including password hashing (using bcrypt) and JWT token creation/validation. It interacts with configuration settings and external libraries like jose and passlib.

methods.name: str hash_password(password: str)
methods.description: Hash a plain password using bcrypt.

methods.name: bool verify_password(plain_password: str, password_hash: str)
methods.description: Verify a plain password against a stored hash.

methods.name: str create_access_token(subject: str | int, expires_minutes: Optional[int] = None, extra_claims: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Create a signed JWT access token with optional expiration and extra claims.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] decode_token(token: str)
methods.description: Decode and validate a JWT, raising an error if invalid.

ctags.name: create_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^def create_access_token(subject: str | int, expires_minutes: Optional[int] = None, extra_claims:/
ctags.signature: (subject: str | int, expires_minutes: Optional[int] = None, extra_claims: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None)
